items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 131:1
items.html: The posterior vessels from the Chazeh [chest] of every Partzuf and downward are sometimes called the external vessels of the Partzuf. (Item 1).
